rows.definition: An activatedExpertPlan is one resolved expert-ring activation pick: its three staging descriptors plus the total resident bytes those descriptors imply.
rows.distinction: It is a concrete pick materialized from the predicted-expert readahead input, not that prediction list itself. Use `activatedexpertplan` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: attachServePlanLedgerDiff folds the post-load planner-vs-allocation-ledger diff into the serve ModelLoadProfile so the load receipt carries the memory-plan delta.
rows.distinction: It ATTACHES the already-computed diff to the profile; it does not compute it (that is DiffMemoryPlanAgainstLedger). Use `attachserveplanledgerdiff` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: buildServeSizingFitPlan prices the same weights plan, budgets, and resolved context into a fitplan.Report for serve-sizing output.
rows.distinction: It produces the pricing REPORT; it is not the serveFitPlanSizing input it consumes nor the fitplan package itself. Use `buildservesizingfitplan` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: BuildSpecRejectionPlan constructs the spec-rejection probability plan that Qwen3.5 MTP sampled rounds consume to decide rejection behavior.
rows.distinction: It BUILDS the plan from a SpecRejectionPlanInput; it is neither the input struct nor the stored plan field on the round. Use `buildspecrejectionplan` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: BuildStrixCandidateArchive creates a deterministic archive of baseTip plus exactly ownedPaths, refusing symlinks and junctions, for Strix hardware validation.
rows.distinction: It is the builder FUNCTION; the artifact it returns is the separate StrixCandidateArchive type. Use `buildstrixcandidatearchive` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateAliases records the candidate alias spellings a tensor role's provenance carries alongside its canonical name.
rows.distinction: It lists ALIAS spellings of one tensor role; it is not the role's Canonical name and not amdgpu's metric-key alias parameters. Use `candidatealiases` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateBlockSize is the block size of the DeepSeek V4.1 candidate KV pool published in the model header.
rows.distinction: It sizes the candidate pool blocks; it is not the CandidateTopKBlocks count nor the CandidateSourceLayerID origin layer. Use `candidateblocksize` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateCacheDisposition is the self-update receipt record of the candidate build-cache reuse state together with its reason.
rows.distinction: It is the RECEIPT RECORD carrying state plus reason; the closed enum it holds is the separate CandidateCacheState type. Use `candidatecachedisposition` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateCachePaths resolves the filesystem paths of the candidate artifact cache entries consulted during HF-hub fetch and self-install.
rows.distinction: It yields candidate CACHE PATHS for lookup; it is not the cache directory itself nor the manifest contents read from them. Use `candidatecachepaths` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateCacheState is the closed enum (disabled, miss, hit, rejected) classifying the self-update candidate build-cache disposition.
rows.distinction: It is the STATE ENUM; the receipt record wrapping state plus reason is the separate CandidateCacheDisposition type. Use `candidatecachestate` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateContent is the proposed markdown body a README-next fragment replaces or appends into its target section.
rows.distinction: It is the PROPOSED content payload; it is not the fragment's Topic nor its TargetSection locator. Use `candidatecontent` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateCost is the cost-model price of reusing one ReuseCandidate inside the radix-KV reuse plan.
rows.distinction: It prices ONE candidate reuse; it is not the ReuseCandidate being priced nor the whole DefaultCostModel. Use `candidatecost` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateCV is the coefficient of variation of the candidate arm's TPS samples in the AMD quantization-run scoreboard.
rows.distinction: It measures spread of the CANDIDATE arm; the paired ReferenceCV covers the reference arm of the same statistics. Use `candidatecv` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateDir is the directory of the candidate build under test, resolved to a repository root before Strix validation or symptom-proof caching.
rows.distinction: It locates the CANDIDATE tree; the baseline or parent directory it is compared against is a different argument. Use `candidatedir` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateDraftTree holds the speculative continuation candidates the n-gram drafter extracts from prompt history.
rows.distinction: It is the RESULT structure of drafting; it is not the NgramDrafter that produces it nor a serving plan. Use `candidatedrafttree` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateElapsedNanoseconds is the wall-clock nanoseconds spent in candidate-only work of a raw-decode receipt, mirroring the first run's timing at the attempt level.
rows.distinction: It times CANDIDATE work only; CPU verification time and non-candidate overhead are excluded and reported separately. Use `candidateelapsednanoseconds` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateKey maps a float64 value to a uint64 whose unsigned order equals the value's numeric order, used to sort and histogram block-sparse indexer candidates.
rows.distinction: It is an ORDERING KEY transform; it is not the candidate value it orders nor the top-K selection result. Use `candidatekey` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateLatency is the per-row gross latency in milliseconds of the candidate call accumulated into turn-avoid cost accounting.
rows.distinction: It is the per-row INPUT latency; the accumulated GrossCandidateLatencyMS and NetCandidateLatencyMS totals are separate receipt fields. Use `candidatelatency` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateLatencyUS is the candidate-arm latency in microseconds reported by the Strix candidate scoreboard and ablation metrics.
rows.distinction: It reports the CANDIDATE arm in microseconds; BaselineLatencyUS covers the baseline arm of the same measurement. Use `candidatelatencyus` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateLCB95 is the lower 95% confidence bound of the candidate arm's mean TPS in the AMD quantization-run scoreboard.
rows.distinction: It bounds the CANDIDATE mean from below; PairedRatioLCB95 bounds the paired ratio instead. Use `candidatelcb95` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateLogits are the cloned device logits captured per step for CPU cross-verification in a raw decode run, and the candidate-side logit vector checked for tolerance against the reference.
rows.distinction: They are the CANDIDATE-side logits; the reference logits they are verified against are a separate series. Use `candidatelogits` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateMeanTokPerS is the mean tokens-per-second of the candidate arm in a macbench prefill-witness summary, paired with the baseline mean to form the ratio.
rows.distinction: It rates the CANDIDATE arm; BaselineMeanTokPerS rates the baseline arm of the same witness. Use `candidatemeantokpers` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateMS is the per-trial GPU milliseconds of the candidate arm recorded in the Q4K/M5 crossover receipt samples.
rows.distinction: It times the CANDIDATE arm; ScalarMS times the scalar baseline arm of the same ArmSamples. Use `candidatems` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidatePickupBlockedBy extracts the deduplicated upstream issue IDs whose dependencies block a candidate issue from pickup.
rows.distinction: It DERIVES the blocker list from DependencyRefs; it is not the BlockedBy field it populates nor the dependency refs themselves. Use `candidatepickupblockedby` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidatePool is the sync.Pool of ForkedCandidate objects reused by the COW page table's lock-free candidate-tree speculation.
rows.distinction: It POOLS candidate branch objects; it is not a ForkedCandidate itself and not the heavyweight SessionBranch registry. Use `candidatepool` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateRatio is the compression ratio held by the V4.1 attention state alongside its candidate mask for incremental forward passes.
rows.distinction: It is the RATIO half of the candidate state; the candidate mask/slice it accompanies is reported separately. Use `candidateratio` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateSelector is the name of the decode-handoff selector the candidate profile used in a modelbench profile comparison.
rows.distinction: It labels the CANDIDATE arm's selector; ControlSelector labels the control arm, and the dflash2 candidate_selector.* weight namespace is unrelated model weights. Use `candidateselector` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateSequence is the sequence slot of the candidate arm within a Strix head-to-head comparison pair, ordered opposite the reference sequence.
rows.distinction: It numbers the CANDIDATE position in the pair; referenceSequence numbers the reference position. Use `candidatesequence` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidateSet is the go/parser FileSet used to parse the candidate task source before function-body extraction in agentbench candidate validation.
rows.distinction: It parses the CANDIDATE source file; the baseline source and the parsed bodies extracted from it are separate artifacts. Use `candidateset` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidate_source_layer is the per-state source-layer marker the V4.1 attention state copies when building a candidate mask the way the reference candidate source layer does.
rows.distinction: It is the attention-STATE marker; the configuration field CandidateSourceLayerID that seeds it is a separate symbol. Use `candidatesourcelayer` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateSourceLayerID is the index of the source layer from which the DeepSeek V4.1 candidate KV pool is projected.
rows.distinction: It names the ORIGIN LAYER of the candidate pool; it is not the CandidateBlockSize or CandidateTopKBlocks geometry fields. Use `candidatesourcelayerid` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: candidatesSet is the flag marking that the V4.1 attention state's candidate pool has been populated for the current pass.
rows.distinction: It is the POPULATED FLAG; the candidate mask and candidateRatio it guards are the state it protects. Use `candidatesset` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateSweepReport is the dry-run/apply result of SweepTopologyCandidates over topology candidate registrations.
rows.distinction: It is the RESULT report; it is not the SweepTopologyCandidates operation nor the CandidateSweepOptions it obeys. Use `candidatesweepreport` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateToken is the candidate-side token at the divergence index recorded in a shadow-traffic divergence artifact.
rows.distinction: It is the CANDIDATE-side token; ReferenceToken holds the reference side of the same divergence. Use `candidatetoken` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CandidateTopKBlocks is the number of top-K blocks retained by the DeepSeek V4.1 candidate pool.
rows.distinction: It counts RETAINED BLOCKS; it is not the CandidateBlockSize of each block nor the CandidateSourceLayerID they project from. Use `candidatetopkblocks` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CategoryPlanAndDecompose covers initial prompts, high-level queries, and replan instructions: the agentopt intra-model-router request-category classifier label for plan-and-decompose shaped prompts.
rows.distinction: It is the ROUTING/CLASSIFICATION category label ('plan_and_decompose') that routes effort - a routing/classification category, NOT a planning algorithm; unlike `planp3-plananddecompose`, it is not the planp3 planning/decompose concept nor an execution Plan data type produced by a planner.

rows.definition: cmdCtxPlans is the CLI handler implementing the fak ctx plans verb that lists context-layer plans.
rows.distinction: It is the CMD-LAYER handler; the ctxplanlint package it invokes and the main.go dispatch line that calls it are separate symbols. Use `cmdctxplans` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: CustomPlanner is the operator-supplied agent.Planner injected into a gym ephemeral gateway in place of the default planner.
rows.distinction: It is an INJECTED planner option; it is not the agent.Planner interface itself nor the SetPlanner seam it feeds. Use `customplanner` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: DeviceBandPlan is the ordered set of device bands that tiles [0, NumLayers), assigning each band of layers to a device for hop transport.
rows.distinction: It is the BAND TILING PLAN; the PartitionPlan derived from it and the individual DeviceBand entries are separate types. Use `devicebandplan` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: DiffMemoryPlanAgainstLedger folds a MemoryPlan's device-scope demands against a DeviceAllocSnapshot ledger into a classified MemoryPlanLedgerDiff.
rows.distinction: It COMPUTES the diff; attaching it to a serve profile is the separate attachServePlanLedgerDiff step. Use `diffmemoryplanagainstledger` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: DRY_RUN_PLAN_VALID is the status marker emitted when a modelbench/macbench MTP dry run validates the runner plan without executing adapters.
rows.distinction: It marks a VALIDATED DRY RUN; it is not the macbenchMTPDryRun flag that requests the mode nor a live execution result. Use `dryrunplanvalid` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: ensemblePlan returns the routing Plan for a multi-member ensemble tool call, re-routing the subject at dispatch without re-recording it.
rows.distinction: It plans ENSEMBLE dispatch only; single-model tool routing and the recorded Subject classification it reuses are separate paths. Use `ensembleplan` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.

rows.definition: EnterPlanMode is the tool name in the guard/adjudicator default-policy allow-list that permits agents to request plan mode.
rows.distinction: It is one ALLOWLISTED TOOL NAME; the surrounding read-only-MCP surface and its sibling tools Monitor and ReportFindings are distinct entries. Use `enterplanmode` for this exact symbol; unlike `x-ci-coverage-plan-blockplan`, it is not the family umbrella identifier.
